title: Rearrange Words in a Sentence
description: Rearrange the words in a sentence by their lengths in increasing order. If lengths are equal, maintain original relative order.
pseudocode:
1. words = text.toLowerCase().split(' ')
2. words.sort((a, b) => a.length - b.length)
3. words[0] = words[0][0].toUpperCase() + words[0].slice(1)
4. return words.join(' ')

steps.note: Split the sentence into an array of lowercase words.
Sort words by length. Since 'it' (2) < 'keep' (4) and 'cool' (4), 'it' comes first.
Capitalize the first word of the sentence.
Join the array back into a sentence string.
